levels.name: Identify
levels.title: Water Treatment 1
levels.blurb: Recognize and identify every asset from source to tap. Name it, understand its basic purpose, and know when to notice and report a concern.

levels.name: Operate
levels.title: Water Treatment 2
levels.blurb: Operate the assets you learned to identify: normal operation, monitoring, and routine tasks.

levels.name: Troubleshoot
levels.title: Water Treatment 3
levels.blurb: Diagnose and respond: recognize what is wrong and work through it safely.

levels.name: Optimize
levels.title: Water Treatment 4
levels.blurb: Optimize and decide: tune the system and make operating decisions.
